title: Reproduced: --pdb runs tearDown on skipped unittest test (pytest 5.4-era checkout, commit c98bc4cd3)
evidence_refs: run_command: pytest --assert=plain test_repro.py → 1 skipped; pytest --assert=plain --pdb test_repro.py → 1 skipped, 1 error (NameError in tearDown)

title: Fixed: --pdb no longer runs tearDown on skipped unittest tests (guard in TestCaseFunction.runtest)
evidence_refs: run_command: --assert=plain --pdb test_repro.py → 1 skipped, no error (was 1 skipped, 1 error)

title: Verified: with --pdb tearDown runs for non-skipped tests only; test_unittest.py results identical to baseline
evidence_refs: run_command: in-process pytest.main --pdb on 3-test unittest class → '2 passed, 1 skipped', tearDown calls == [test_1, test_2] (skipped test_3 absent)
run_command: testing/test_unittest.py → 43 failed, 7 passed, 9 skipped both with and without the fix (baseline identical)
